description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Sri Lanka Deposit Insurance and Liquidity support scheme Regulations No. 1 of 2021
categorisation: This gazette contains amendments to financial regulations (Sri Lanka Deposit Insurance and Liquidity Support Scheme Regulations) made under the Monetary Law Act by the Monetary Board. It involves legal/regulatory changes to banking and deposit insurance rules, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
